changelog: E7 tilføjer generic accessible forms og server-side validation.
Ordered submit action chains understøtter mail, save og safe redirect med logging/error policy.
Signed HTTPS webhook bruger HMAC SHA-256, bounded timeout/retry og WordPress safe HTTP API.
Modal/popup core tilføjer ARIA, focus trap, ESC, scroll lock samt click/time/scroll/context triggers.
Passive interaction runtime konverterer ikke eksisterende sider eller Vehicle/Event/Gallery.
